Vacancy for Assistant Professor in Statistics & Demography
Friday, 24 January 2025
4900 Hits
Recruitment for the post of Assistant Professor (Statistics & Demography):
Qualification & Experience:
MSc (Health Statistics /Medical Statistics /Biostatistics /Statistics) with Ph D from a recognized University
.
Candidates with Experience of working in Medical College will be preferred.
Eligible candidates should submit the applications with the prescribed proforma (available
here
) with photocopies of academic and experience certificates to the office of:
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102
latest by 28/02/2025. The appointments would be on adhoc basis till the meeting of next Selection Committee of MUHS.
Salary:
As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age
: Upper age limit 38 years for open category and 43 years for reserved category.
SECRETARY
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
